audit_question: What event-log, artifact, checksum, or schema failure opens an incident?
incident_trigger: missing event log, checksum mismatch, schema mismatch, regenerated figure mismatch, deleted packet, or unreviewed derived CSV mutation
severity_rule: high: suspend source-patch safety wording until owner and artifact evidence are restored
containment_action: mark local timing claim unsupported, freeze report wording, preserve current artifacts, and stop using regenerated outputs
recovery_action: restore archive or rerun pinned packet, regenerate CSV/PNG, verify checksums and negative control, then log old/new disposition
notification_target: Performance Tests reviewer plus report maintainer
rollback_scope: rollback local timing wording, figures, and recommendations tied to the missing packet event trail
postmortem_record: record failed gate, missing artifact or event, affected report wording, restored packet, validation command, and prevention change
reopen_condition: unlogged packet mutation or deletion makes local timing wording unsupported
supported_claim: the current artifact supports benchmark causality, not source-patch safety
blocked_claim: a selector/source patch is safe because aggregate timing improves
